title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Gustavus Adolphus College
description: Ten under-21-safe food runs with directly documented evening hours, ranging from on-campus dining and Saint Peter stops to options in nearby Mankato.

cards.title: Stay on Campus at The Market Place
cards.subtitle: Jackson Campus Center dining until 9:30 p.m.
cards.notes: Head to the Jackson Campus Center before 9:30 p.m.; the published meal-plan guide identifies The Market Place as the main campus dining room.
cards.short_summary: The closest documented evening-food option is inside Gustavus’s own campus center.
cards.evidence_claim: Gustavus’s 2025–2026 meal-plan guide lists Market Place hours through 9:30 p.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Published Market Place hours are Monday–Saturday 7:00 a.m.–9:30 p.m. and Sunday 9:00 a.m.–9:30 p.m.; academic-break schedules may differ.

cards.title: Make a 10 P.M. Grocery Run
cards.subtitle: A Saint Peter store for flexible late-evening provisions
cards.notes: Use the grocery aisles for a customizable evening run and arrive before 10 p.m.; prepared-food departments may close earlier than the main store.
cards.short_summary: A full grocery store provides more flexibility than a single restaurant menu.
cards.evidence_claim: Hy-Vee’s official St. Peter store page lists the store at 1002 Old Minnesota Avenue and says it is open daily until 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: The main store is open daily 6:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.; individual departments can close earlier.

cards.title: Order Pizza on Minnesota Avenue
cards.subtitle: A downtown Saint Peter option open latest on weekends
cards.notes: Choose dine-in, carryout, or delivery, and confirm the service cutoff when ordering; the listed Friday and Saturday closing time is 11 p.m.
cards.short_summary: This downtown pizza stop extends Saint Peter’s documented weekend food window to 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: The current map listing for Godfather’s Pizza at 225 South Minnesota Avenue shows closing at 10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 11 p.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Godfather's Pizza, 225 S Minnesota Ave, St. Peter
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are 11:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 11:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m. Friday–Saturday; verify delivery and dining cutoffs.

cards.title: Take the Stadium Road Pizza Route
cards.subtitle: A Mankato pizza counter open until 10 p.m. on weekends
cards.notes: Plan this as a Mankato drive and arrive before the posted close; Friday and Saturday add an extra hour beyond the weeknight schedule.
cards.short_summary: Jake’s offers a directly documented weekend pizza stop south of Saint Peter.
cards.evidence_claim: Jake’s official location page lists its 330 Stadium Road restaurant until 10 p.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open Sunday–Thursday 11:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m. and Friday–Saturday 11:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.; allow driving time from Saint Peter.

cards.title: End the Evening at Perkins
cards.subtitle: A sit-down Mankato option through 11 p.m. on weekends
cards.notes: Use this for a seated meal or bakery pickup, allowing enough travel time from Saint Peter before the earlier Sunday-through-Thursday close.
cards.short_summary: Perkins adds a late weekend sit-down alternative to the faster drive-through runs.
cards.evidence_claim: Perkins’s official Mankato page lists the restaurant at 1790 Madison Avenue until 11 p.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Perkins at 1790 Madison Ave Mankato, MN
cards.access_notes: Restaurant hours are 6:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 6:00 a.m.–11:00 p.m. Friday–Saturday; allow travel time.

cards.title: Use the Madison Avenue Midnight Window
cards.subtitle: A Mankato restaurant and drive-through open until midnight
cards.notes: Check the day before leaving Saint Peter: this location reaches midnight Monday through Saturday but closes one hour earlier on Sunday.
cards.short_summary: Wendy’s supplies a documented midnight option on six nights of the week.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official page for 1545 Madison Avenue lists restaurant and drive-through service until midnight Monday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-through hours end at midnight Monday–Saturday and 11:00 p.m. Sunday; allow travel time from Saint Peter.

cards.entity_name: Taco Bell at 145 St. Andrews Drive
cards.title: Take the St. Andrews Drive-Through
cards.subtitle: A Mankato drive-through operating as late as 3 a.m.
cards.notes: Use the drive-through after the dining room closes; verify the posted day because Thursday through Saturday run one hour later than other nights.
cards.short_summary: This location has the latest directly documented drive-through window in the set.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official location page lists drive-through hours until 2 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 3 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell at 145 St. Andrews Dr, Mankato
cards.access_notes: Drive-through closes at 2:00 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 3:00 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; dine-in closes earlier. Allow travel time.

cards.title: Choose the Madison Avenue Drive-Through
cards.subtitle: A second Mankato late window on the east side
cards.notes: Route to the Madison Avenue address, not the St. Andrews store; after 11 p.m., plan on drive-through service rather than dining inside.
cards.short_summary: A separate Taco Bell address provides another verified post-midnight route in Mankato.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official page for 1819 Madison Avenue lists drive-through service until 2 a.m. most nights and 3 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell at 1819 Madison Avenue, Mankato
cards.access_notes: Drive-through closes at 2:00 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 3:00 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; dine-in closes earlier. Allow travel time.

cards.title: Order from Stadium Boulevard by Midnight
cards.subtitle: A Mankato pizza shop with a posted midnight close
cards.notes: Place the order early enough for preparation or delivery and confirm the live closing display; the official store page currently shows midnight.
cards.short_summary: Domino’s adds a late pizza carryout or delivery option near Mankato’s university district.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official page for 300 Stadium Boulevard in Mankato displays a current closing time of midnight.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 300 Stadium Blvd, Mankato
cards.access_notes: The official location page currently shows service until 12:00 a.m.; ordering cutoffs can precede closing, so check before driving from Saint Peter.

cards.entity_name: Jersey Mike's Subs at 510 South Riverfront Drive
cards.title: Make a Riverfront Sub Run
cards.subtitle: A Mankato sandwich stop open until 10 p.m. daily
cards.notes: Allow for the drive from Saint Peter and order before the posted 10 p.m. close; use the Riverfront address to avoid the separate Adams Street shop.
cards.short_summary: The Riverfront shop supplies a straightforward, daily late-evening sandwich option.
cards.evidence_claim: Jersey Mike’s official location results list the 510 South Riverfront Drive shop in Mankato as open daily until 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: The location is listed open seven days from 10:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.; allow driving time from Saint Peter and verify holiday exceptions.

warnings: Late-night options in Saint Peter are limited; six cards require a drive to nearby Mankato. Hours can change during holidays or academic breaks, so users should recheck before departure.
Godfather's Pizza hours are supported by its current map listing because a location-specific official business page was not available.
